# `Ui.Transition`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Ui.Transition — typed CSS transitions for `Ipe.Ui`.

`Transition.attribute [property "background-color", duration 200,
easing easeOut]` builds the CSS transition shorthand from typed
`Step`s; pair with `Background.hoverColor` so the browser animates
the change between base + `:hover` states.  Auto-wrapped in
`@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` by default for
a11y; opt out via `attributeUnsafe` ONLY when motion is
semantically required (loading spinner, progress indicator).

The shorthand is emitted through `Ui.transition`, whose value is
scanned by the native CSS sanitiser at the render sink.
